meta.status_detail: Round 1 (workspace proposal 3674c0c1) migration of the JOURNAL_STYLE_PRESETS dict literal into per-journal JSON. Independently verified 2026-09-11 against nature.com/nature/for-authors/formatting-guide and nature.com/nature/for-authors/final-submission. heading_numbering_visible, emphasis_style, and the caption/SI/indent keys were left unset in the original dict entry -- not addressed by the pages checked in that pass -- and stay entirely absent here rather than being backfilled with a guess.

source.note: In-text citations are superscript numerals assigned in order of first appearance, placed after punctuation (paraphrased from the guide in the original in-code comment; not a direct quote).

source.quote: in RGB color and at 300 dpi or higher resolution

source.note: Line art needs 800-1200 dpi per the guide; 800 is the floor value used here (paraphrased range, not a direct quote in the original comment).
